name: Visayas Championship 2017

venue.name: [Parkmall](http://www.parkmallcebu.com/)
venue.address: Ouano Avenue, North Reclamation Area Mandaue City, Cebu
venue.details: West Lobby in between First Family Appliance and Samsung

information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation, scoresheets and a KungFu YueHun 2x2) starts at Php 300.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event, this is up to June 30, 2017 only for the early bird. Regular registration fee of Php 350 will apply starting in July. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on August 27, 2017 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Strictly no refund and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
